dialogues.jp: さて、授業も終わったし、環のところへ行くか。
dialogues.en: Classes are over... I wonder where Tamaki is.
dialogues.text: Classes are over... I wonder where Tamaki is.

dialogues.jp: 多分、巫女同好会も一人だと淋しいに違いない。
dialogues.en:
Likely holding her usual, lonely post at the Miko
Appreciation Club.
dialogues.text:
Likely holding her usual, lonely post at the Miko
Appreciation Club.

dialogues.jp: 何とか部員が増えてくれるといいのだが……。
dialogues.en: It'd be good if the club gets more members...
dialogues.text: It'd be good if the club gets more members...

dialogues.jp: 俺は巫女同好会の部室へと入る。
dialogues.en: I traveled to the clubroom and entered.
dialogues.text: I traveled to the clubroom and entered.

dialogues.jp: 「おーい、環」
dialogues.en: "Heeey, Tamaki."
dialogues.text: "Heeey, Tamaki."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「あら、朝倉様」
dialogues.en: "My, Asakura-sama."
dialogues.text: "My, Asakura-sama."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「よお、朝倉」
dialogues.en: "Yo, Asakura."
dialogues.text: "Yo, Asakura."

dialogues.jp: 部室には既に、杉並が来ていた。
dialogues.en: I noticed Suginami just a little too late.
dialogues.text: I noticed Suginami just a little too late.

dialogues.jp: どうりで、教室にいないと思った。
dialogues.en:
If I'd noticed earlier, I might've thought twice about
entering.
dialogues.text:
If I'd noticed earlier, I might've thought twice about
entering.

dialogues.jp: 「どうしたんだよ」
dialogues.en: "What're you doing here?"
dialogues.text: "What're you doing here?"

dialogues.jp: 俺は部室の椅子に腰を掛ける。
dialogues.en: I took a seat on one of the chairs.
dialogues.text: I took a seat on one of the chairs.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「いや、個人的に陰陽道には興味があるからな」
dialogues.en:
"I have a vested interest in the ways of the Onmyoudou, of
course."
dialogues.text:
"I have a vested interest in the ways of the Onmyoudou, of
course."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「杉並様の推測って、個性的で面白いんですよ」
dialogues.en: "Suginami's insights are very interesting to discuss."
dialogues.text: "Suginami's insights are very interesting to discuss."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「ふーん」
dialogues.en: "Hmm."
dialogues.text: "Hmm."

dialogues.jp: 何となく。
dialogues.en: ...Hey now.
dialogues.text: ...Hey now.

dialogues.jp:
何となく、邪魔されているような気がするのは、
俺だけだろうか？
dialogues.en: Am I the one being the third wheel, this time?
dialogues.text: Am I the one being the third wheel, this time?

dialogues.jp: 「環、今日は何をする予定なんだ？」
dialogues.en: "Tamaki, do you have any plans for today?"
dialogues.text: "Tamaki, do you have any plans for today?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「そうですね。今日もチラシを配ろうかとは思
　ってるんですけど」
dialogues.en:
"Ah, that's right. I was thinking of distributing leaflets
to advertise the club."
dialogues.text:
"Ah, that's right. I was thinking of distributing leaflets
to advertise the club."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「では、俺達も手伝おう」
dialogues.en: "In that case, allow us to help."
dialogues.text: "In that case, allow us to help."

dialogues.jp: って、杉並、お前が先に言うな！
dialogues.en: Hey, Suginami, don't speak for me!
dialogues.text: Hey, Suginami, don't speak for me!

dialogues.jp: 杉並は、俺の方にニヤリと笑いかける。
dialogues.en: All he did though, was look at me with a knowing grin.
dialogues.text: All he did though, was look at me with a knowing grin.

dialogues.jp: こいつ、気づいててやってるな……。
dialogues.en: He always notices these things...
dialogues.text: He always notices these things...

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「じゃあ、早速行きましょうか？」
dialogues.en: "In that case, shall we get started?"
dialogues.text: "In that case, shall we get started?"

dialogues.jp: と、俺達が立ち上がろうとした瞬間、
dialogues.en: But, just as we stood up from our seats,
dialogues.text: But, just as we stood up from our seats,

dialogues.jp: ドンドン、と部室のドアをノックする音が響く。
dialogues.en:
The sound of someone knocking on the door echoed throughout
the room.
dialogues.text:
The sound of someone knocking on the door echoed throughout
the room.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「あら、誰かしら？」
dialogues.en: "My, who might that be?"
dialogues.text: "My, who might that be?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「入部希望者かもしれないぞ」
dialogues.en: "Perhaps someone who wants to join?"
dialogues.text: "Perhaps someone who wants to join?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「だと、いいんですけど」
dialogues.en: "It'd be wonderful if that was the case."
dialogues.text: "It'd be wonderful if that was the case."

dialogues.jp: 環がドアを開ける。
dialogues.en: Tamaki opened the door.
dialogues.text: Tamaki opened the door.

dialogues.jp:
すると、そこにはとても部員希望と思えない、
体格のいい男子学生が立っている。
dialogues.en:
The person knocking was a male student with a good physique.
Not someone you'd expect to want to join...
dialogues.text:
The person knocking was a male student with a good physique.
Not someone you'd expect to want to join...

dialogues.jp:
って、その前に野球部のユニフォームを着てい
る。
dialogues.en: ...Right, that's the uniform of the baseball club, too.
dialogues.text: ...Right, that's the uniform of the baseball club, too.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「あ、あの、何か……？」
dialogues.en: "U, um, what might the matter be...?"
dialogues.text: "U, um, what might the matter be...?"

dialogues.jp:
デンっと立っている男子学生に、環は威圧され
ている。
dialogues.en:
He towered over Tamaki. It looked like he was going to
coerce her.
dialogues.text:
He towered over Tamaki. It looked like he was going to
coerce her.

dialogues.speaker: Male Student
dialogues.jp: 「入ってもいいか？」
dialogues.en: "May I enter?"
dialogues.text: "May I enter?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「は、はい。どうぞ」
dialogues.en: "P, please do."
dialogues.text: "P, please do."

dialogues.jp:
男子学生は、狭い部室の中を遠慮せずに入って
くる。
dialogues.en: The student walked in and took a seat in the narrow room.
dialogues.text: The student walked in and took a seat in the narrow room.

dialogues.jp: そいつのお陰で、室内は妙に密度が高くなる。
dialogues.en:
The density of the room seemed to increase threefold with
him around.
dialogues.text:
The density of the room seemed to increase threefold with
him around.

dialogues.speaker: Male Student
dialogues.jp: 「実は、野球部の必勝祈願をして欲しい」
dialogues.en:
"I came here to request a victory prayer for the baseball
club."
dialogues.text:
"I came here to request a victory prayer for the baseball
club."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「必勝祈願？」
dialogues.en: "A victory prayer?"
dialogues.text: "A victory prayer?"

dialogues.speaker: Male Student
dialogues.jp:
「地区予選が始まったんだが、うちは万年予選
　落ちだ。勝ったことがない」
dialogues.en:
"The district preliminaries are about to begin. We have
never won a match since the school opened."
dialogues.text:
"The district preliminaries are about to begin. We have
never won a match since the school opened."

dialogues.jp:
野球部のキャプテンと思われる男子学生は、太
い声で言う。
dialogues.en:
The student, seemingly the captain of the baseball club,
spoke with a booming voice.
dialogues.text:
The student, seemingly the captain of the baseball club,
spoke with a booming voice.

dialogues.speaker: Male Student
dialogues.jp:
「３年は、言わずと知れて今年が最後だ。一度
　ぐらい、勝利というものを実感したいのだ」
dialogues.en:
"This will be the last year for us 3rd year students. Just
once, we would like to taste victory."
dialogues.text:
"This will be the last year for us 3rd year students. Just
once, we would like to taste victory."

dialogues.jp: 環は当惑した顔をしている。
dialogues.en: Tamaki's face was a picture of bewilderment.
dialogues.text: Tamaki's face was a picture of bewilderment.

dialogues.jp: 確かに、うちの野球部は弱い。
dialogues.en:
It's a well-known fact around the school that our baseball
club is weak.
dialogues.text:
It's a well-known fact around the school that our baseball
club is weak.

dialogues.jp:
５０戦中１勝もしていない、というもっぱらの
噂だ。
dialogues.en:
In 50 matches, they haven't won even one game. The heckling
was endless.
dialogues.text:
In 50 matches, they haven't won even one game. The heckling
was endless.

dialogues.jp: 近々、廃部になるという噂もある。
dialogues.en:
Recently, there was even talk that the club would be
disbanded.
dialogues.text:
Recently, there was even talk that the club would be
disbanded.

dialogues.speaker: Male Student
dialogues.jp:
「今回、１勝もできないと、間違えなくうちの
　存続は危うい。もう、藁にもすがる思いなん
　だ」
dialogues.en:
"If we fail again to win even once, the future of the club
would be in danger. This is our last chance."
dialogues.text:
"If we fail again to win even once, the future of the club
would be in danger. This is our last chance."

dialogues.speaker: Male Student
dialogues.jp: 「頼む」
dialogues.en: "Please!"
dialogues.text: "Please!"

dialogues.jp: 男子学生は、環に坊主頭を深々と下げる。
dialogues.en: The student bowed his shaven head deeply to Tamaki.
dialogues.text: The student bowed his shaven head deeply to Tamaki.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「そ、そんな。頭を上げてください」
dialogues.en: "N, no! Please lift your head!"
dialogues.text: "N, no! Please lift your head!"

dialogues.jp: 環は驚いて男子学生に言う。
dialogues.en: The surprised Tamaki quickly replied.
dialogues.text: The surprised Tamaki quickly replied.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「で、でも、必勝祈願なんて……」
dialogues.en: "B, but.... a victory prayer..."
dialogues.text: "B, but.... a victory prayer..."

dialogues.jp: 多分、環は野球部の未来は見えないのだろう。
dialogues.en: I guess Tamaki can't see the future of the baseball club.
dialogues.text: I guess Tamaki can't see the future of the baseball club.

dialogues.jp: 自信の無さそうな顔をしている。
dialogues.en: Her face was full of doubt.
dialogues.text: Her face was full of doubt.

dialogues.speaker: Male Student
dialogues.jp:
「聞くところによると、君は不思議な力がある
　らしいな。その力でなんとか……」
dialogues.en:
"I have heard from several sources that you possess a
mysterious power. If you could somehow use it..."
dialogues.text:
"I have heard from several sources that you possess a
mysterious power. If you could somehow use it..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「そんな、無理です。勝負事には……」
dialogues.en: "That's too much, I can't use it for competitions like..."
dialogues.text: "That's too much, I can't use it for competitions like..."

dialogues.speaker: Male Student
dialogues.jp: 「頼む、この通りだ」
dialogues.en: "Please, this is the only way."
dialogues.text: "Please, this is the only way."

dialogues.jp: 男子学生は、再び頭を下げる。
dialogues.en: Once again, his head bowed down.
dialogues.text: Once again, his head bowed down.

dialogues.jp: 環は無言で考え込んでしまう。
dialogues.en: Tamaki stayed silent, thinking.
dialogues.text: Tamaki stayed silent, thinking.

dialogues.jp: ったく、自分達で練習すれば済むことだろうが。
dialogues.en:
Geez, if they want to win, why don't they just practice
more.
dialogues.text:
Geez, if they want to win, why don't they just practice
more.

dialogues.jp: 環に頼むのは筋が違う。
dialogues.en:
They're barking up the wrong tree if they actually want to
improve their club.
dialogues.text:
They're barking up the wrong tree if they actually want to
improve their club.

dialogues.jp: 実際、環だって困っているし。
dialogues.en: And it'd be a huge bother to Tamaki as well.
dialogues.text: And it'd be a huge bother to Tamaki as well.

dialogues.jp:
俺は野球部のキャプテンに反論したいのだが
……。
dialogues.en:
I was completely against what the baseball club captain
wanted...
dialogues.text:
I was completely against what the baseball club captain
wanted...

dialogues.jp:
が、それは環が決めることなので俺は黙ってい
る。
dialogues.en: But since this was Tamaki's decision, I stayed silent.
dialogues.text: But since this was Tamaki's decision, I stayed silent.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「……わかりました。やってみましょう」
dialogues.en: "...I understand. I will do it."
dialogues.text: "...I understand. I will do it."

dialogues.jp: やっぱり、環は断りきれない……か。
dialogues.en: She just can't say no to people, huh...
dialogues.text: She just can't say no to people, huh...

dialogues.jp: 環は、困っている人を見ると、放っておけない。
dialogues.en: She just can't leave people in distress alone.
dialogues.text: She just can't leave people in distress alone.

dialogues.jp:
まあ、そこが環のいいところでもあるのだが
……。
dialogues.en: Well, that's the good part about her, yet...
dialogues.text: Well, that's the good part about her, yet...

dialogues.speaker: Male Student
dialogues.jp: 「本当か？　ありがとう！」
dialogues.en: "Really? Thank you!"
dialogues.text: "Really? Thank you!"

dialogues.jp:
男子学生は、環の手を取ってお礼を言う。本当
に、心の底から安心したようだった。
dialogues.en:
The male student grabbed her hand and thanked her profusely.
It really seemed to mean a lot to him...
dialogues.text:
The male student grabbed her hand and thanked her profusely.
It really seemed to mean a lot to him...

dialogues.jp: ま、よっぽど切羽詰ってたんだろうな。
dialogues.en: Seems like he was at his wits' end.
dialogues.text: Seems like he was at his wits' end.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「じゃあ、こちらで行いますから」
dialogues.en: "Please follow me."
dialogues.text: "Please follow me."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「朝倉様、すいません。少し留守にしますので、
　お願いしてもいいですか？」
dialogues.en:
"Asakura-sama, could you take care of things in my
abscence?"
dialogues.text:
"Asakura-sama, could you take care of things in my
abscence?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「ああ」
dialogues.en: "Sure."
dialogues.text: "Sure."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「では、行きましょう」
dialogues.en: "Let's get ready."
dialogues.text: "Let's get ready."

dialogues.jp: と、環と男子学生は外へ出て行ってしまった。
dialogues.en: Tamaki and the male student left the room.
dialogues.text: Tamaki and the male student left the room.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「やれやれ、だな」
dialogues.en: "Hoo boy."
dialogues.text: "Hoo boy."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「なんでお前がやれやれ、なんだよ」
dialogues.en: "Why are you saying that?"
dialogues.text: "Why are you saying that?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「お前のためを思って言ってやってるんだぞ。
　胡ノ宮嬢を独り占めできないから」
dialogues.en:
"I was just speaking on your behalf, since you can't
monopolize Konomiya anymore."
dialogues.text:
"I was just speaking on your behalf, since you can't
monopolize Konomiya anymore."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「うるさいな。だったら、お前も来るなよ」
dialogues.en: "Shut up. You shouldn't have came here, either."
dialogues.text: "Shut up. You shouldn't have came here, either."

dialogues.jp: しかし、杉並の言うことももっともだ。
dialogues.en: His words rang of the truth, though.
dialogues.text: His words rang of the truth, though.

dialogues.jp:
環の予知能力がみんなに知られてから、環の周
りは騒がしくなっている。
dialogues.en:
Since Tamaki's clairvoyance was found out, trouble had
brewed all around her.
dialogues.text:
Since Tamaki's clairvoyance was found out, trouble had
brewed all around her.

dialogues.jp:
環の意志とは関係の無いところで、いろいろな
ことが動いている。
dialogues.en:
Several things started happening without her knowledge or
acceptance.
dialogues.text:
Several things started happening without her knowledge or
acceptance.

dialogues.jp: でも、だから俺が一緒にいるんじゃないか。
dialogues.en: But... that's why I'm with her, isn't it.
dialogues.text: But... that's why I'm with her, isn't it.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「せいぜい、お姫様を守ってやれよ」
dialogues.en: "Do your best to protect your princess."
dialogues.text: "Do your best to protect your princess."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「だから、うるさいって」
dialogues.en: "Yep, and that's why you need to shut up."
dialogues.text: "Yep, and that's why you need to shut up."

dialogues.jp: と、俺達が言い争いをしていると、
dialogues.en: As our usual argument continued on,
dialogues.text: As our usual argument continued on,

dialogues.jp: コンコンと、ドアをノックする音がする。
dialogues.en: A knock on the door interrupted us.
dialogues.text: A knock on the door interrupted us.

dialogues.jp: 「あれ？　もう必勝祈願終わったのかな？」
dialogues.en: "Ehh? The victory prayer's over already?"
dialogues.text: "Ehh? The victory prayer's over already?"

dialogues.jp: ちょっと、早過ぎないか？
dialogues.en: That seemed awfully fast.
dialogues.text: That seemed awfully fast.

dialogues.jp: 俺は部室のドアを開ける。
dialogues.en: I opened the door to the clubroom.
dialogues.text: I opened the door to the clubroom.

dialogues.jp:
すると、ドアの前で二人の女子学生が立ってい
る。
dialogues.en: Unexpectedly, there were two female students standing there.
dialogues.text: Unexpectedly, there were two female students standing there.

dialogues.jp: 「はい？　あの、何か……」
dialogues.en: "Uh, yes? How can I help you?"
dialogues.text: "Uh, yes? How can I help you?"

dialogues.jp:
二人の女学生は、一人はお下げ髪で、一人は茶
色い髪をしている。
dialogues.en:
One of them had light brown hair, the other one had her hair
tied in braids.
dialogues.text:
One of them had light brown hair, the other one had her hair
tied in braids.

dialogues.speaker: Female Student 1
dialogues.jp: 「あ、あの、入部希望の張り紙をみて……」
dialogues.en:
"Uh, uhm, I read the poster about this club recruiting
members..."
dialogues.text:
"Uh, uhm, I read the poster about this club recruiting
members..."

dialogues.jp: え？　マジ？
dialogues.en: Ehh? Don't tell me...?
dialogues.text: Ehh? Don't tell me...?

dialogues.jp: 何だか、すごく嬉しくなる。
dialogues.en: I felt a sudden wave of happiness rushing over me.
dialogues.text: I felt a sudden wave of happiness rushing over me.

dialogues.jp: 環、喜ぶだろうな……。
dialogues.en: Tamaki will be overjoyed by this...
dialogues.text: Tamaki will be overjoyed by this...

dialogues.jp: 「もしかして、入部希望者？」
dialogues.en: "Do you two want to join the club?"
dialogues.text: "Do you two want to join the club?"

dialogues.jp:
二人の女学生は、コクリと頷く。服装から見る
に、付属生だ。たぶん、美春の同級生だろう。
dialogues.en:
They nodded in unison. From their uniforms, they're from the
attached school... the same grade as Miharu.
dialogues.text:
They nodded in unison. From their uniforms, they're from the
attached school... the same grade as Miharu.

dialogues.jp:
「ほんと！？　いやあ、いらっしゃい。どうぞ
　どうぞ。入ってください」
dialogues.en: "Really!? Welcome, welcome! Please come in!"
dialogues.text: "Really!? Welcome, welcome! Please come in!"

dialogues.jp: と、二人を過剰に歓迎し、中へ招き入れる。
dialogues.en: I literally pushed them inside.
dialogues.text: I literally pushed them inside.

dialogues.jp: 「入部希望者だ。杉並、ちょっとどけ」
dialogues.en: "Move a bit, Suginami, there's serious business now."
dialogues.text: "Move a bit, Suginami, there's serious business now."

dialogues.jp: と、杉並の座っていた椅子に座らせる。
dialogues.en: I hurriedly sat on the chair next to him.
dialogues.text: I hurriedly sat on the chair next to him.

dialogues.jp:
「だけど、環から何も聞いてないよな。こうい
　う場合、どうするんだ？」
dialogues.en: "Tamaki didn't tell me anything though... what should I do?"
dialogues.text: "Tamaki didn't tell me anything though... what should I do?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「とりあえず、名前とクラスでも書いてもらえ
　ばどうだ？」
dialogues.en:
"Taking down their names and their class would be a good
start."
dialogues.text:
"Taking down their names and their class would be a good
start."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「なるほど。たまには役に立つじゃないか」
dialogues.en: "Ah, true. I guess you're not always a good-for-nothing."
dialogues.text: "Ah, true. I guess you're not always a good-for-nothing."

dialogues.jp:
俺は、机の上にあった紙とシャープペンシルを
二人に渡し、名前とクラスを記入してもらう。
dialogues.en:
I gave them a piece of paper and a sharp pencil, instructing
them to write their names and class.
dialogues.text:
I gave them a piece of paper and a sharp pencil, instructing
them to write their names and class.

dialogues.jp: そこへ、いいタイミングで環が帰ってくる。
dialogues.en: Tamaki then returned, perfect timing.
dialogues.text: Tamaki then returned, perfect timing.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「あら？」
dialogues.en: "Ah?"
dialogues.text: "Ah?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「入部希望者だって」
dialogues.en: "These people want to join, Tamaki."
dialogues.text: "These people want to join, Tamaki."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「え？　本当ですか？」
dialogues.en: "Ehh? Really?"
dialogues.text: "Ehh? Really?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「ああ。もう、名前も書いてもらった」
dialogues.en: "Yeah. They've wrote down their names already."
dialogues.text: "Yeah. They've wrote down their names already."

dialogues.jp: 俺は少し得意げに、入部用紙を環に見せる。
dialogues.en: I showed her the paper with pride.
dialogues.text: I showed her the paper with pride.

dialogues.jp: 『まあ』と、環の顔がほころぶ。
dialogues.en: "My", she said, as she began to smile broadly.
dialogues.text: "My", she said, as she began to smile broadly.

dialogues.jp: 女子学生たちは、環の顔をみて、お辞儀する。
dialogues.en: The two students looked at Tamaki, and bowed.
dialogues.text: The two students looked at Tamaki, and bowed.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「よくいらしてくれましたね」
dialogues.en: "Welcome to the club."
dialogues.text: "Welcome to the club."

dialogues.speaker: Female Student 1
dialogues.en: "Thank you..."
dialogues.text: "Thank you..."

dialogues.speaker: Female Student 2
dialogues.jp: 「よろしくお願いします、胡ノ宮先輩」
dialogues.en: "Pleased to meet you, Konomiya-senpai."
dialogues.text: "Pleased to meet you, Konomiya-senpai."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「どうして入部しようと思ったんだ？」
dialogues.en: "Why did you think of joining this club?"
dialogues.text: "Why did you think of joining this club?"

dialogues.jp:
やはりその動機に興味があるのか、俺が聞こう
と思っていた言葉を、杉並が代弁してくれる。
dialogues.en:
I was interested in their motives too, but Suginami beat me
to the punch.
dialogues.text:
I was interested in their motives too, but Suginami beat me
to the punch.

dialogues.speaker: Female Student 1
dialogues.en: "Well, actually..."
dialogues.text: "Well, actually..."

dialogues.jp: 二人は顔を見合わせる。
dialogues.en: They glanced at each other.
dialogues.text: They glanced at each other.

dialogues.speaker: Female Student 2
dialogues.jp:
「胡ノ宮先輩と、巫女服に憧れて……。ほら、
　先輩ってカッコイイじゃないですか」
dialogues.en:
"We wanted to be like Konomiya-senpai, in her Miko outfit...
she's really cool."
dialogues.text:
"We wanted to be like Konomiya-senpai, in her Miko outfit...
she's really cool."

dialogues.speaker: Female Student 1
dialogues.jp:
「白河先輩を、弓矢で救ったところ、私、見て
　たんです。なんだか憧れちゃって」
dialogues.en:
"That time when she used her bow and arrows to save
Shirakawa-senpai... I saw it, and I wanted to be like her."
dialogues.text:
"That time when she used her bow and arrows to save
Shirakawa-senpai... I saw it, and I wanted to be like her."

dialogues.jp: 環は思わず顔を赤らめる。
dialogues.en: Tamaki started to blush a deep red.
dialogues.text: Tamaki started to blush a deep red.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「あ、ありがとうございます……」
dialogues.en: "T, thank you for your kind words..."
dialogues.text: "T, thank you for your kind words..."

dialogues.jp:
よっぽど嬉しいんだろう。こっちが見ていても
それが良く分かる。
dialogues.en:
She's really happy now... it's easy to tell from her
expression.
dialogues.text:
She's really happy now... it's easy to tell from her
expression.

dialogues.jp: 俺までが嬉しい気分になってしまう。
dialogues.en: Seeing her like that made me happy too.
dialogues.text: Seeing her like that made me happy too.

dialogues.jp: 「やったな」
dialogues.en: "This looks good, Tamaki."
dialogues.text: "This looks good, Tamaki."

dialogues.jp: 俺は環に小声で言う。
dialogues.en: I whispered to her.
dialogues.text: I whispered to her.

dialogues.jp: 環は、小さく頷く。
dialogues.en: She gave me a small nod in return.
dialogues.text: She gave me a small nod in return.

dialogues.jp:
二人の新入部員は、今日は用事があるので、明
日からと言って去っていった。
dialogues.en:
The two new members had other matters to attend to today,
but promised to come back tomorrow.
dialogues.text:
The two new members had other matters to attend to today,
but promised to come back tomorrow.

dialogues.jp:
環は、二人のために、神社から持ってきた巫女
装束を部室に置いていた。
dialogues.en: Tamaki vowed to bring Miko outfits from the shrine for them.
dialogues.text: Tamaki vowed to bring Miko outfits from the shrine for them.

dialogues.jp: その姿は、なんだかとても楽しそうだった。
dialogues.en: It's gonna be fun to watch.
dialogues.text: It's gonna be fun to watch.

dialogues.jp: ◆必勝祈願◆
dialogues.en: ◆Victory Prayer?◆
dialogues.text: ◆Victory Prayer?◆

dialogues.jp:
巫女同好会へ行くと、必勝祈願にと野球部の部
員が訪れる。
dialogues.en:
The captain of the baseball club approached the Miko
Appreciation Club to request a victory prayer.
dialogues.text:
The captain of the baseball club approached the Miko
Appreciation Club to request a victory prayer.

dialogues.jp: しぶしぶながらも、環はその必勝祈願をする。
dialogues.en: Although a bit hesitant, Tamaki agreed to carry it out.
dialogues.text: Although a bit hesitant, Tamaki agreed to carry it out.

dialogues.jp:
その間に、入部したいという女子学生が部室を
訪れる。
dialogues.en:
While she was doing the victory prayer, two female students
inquired about joining the club.
dialogues.text:
While she was doing the victory prayer, two female students
inquired about joining the club.

dialogues.jp: 聞けば、環と巫女装束に憧れたのだという。
dialogues.en:
They were inspired by Tamaki's exploits while in her Miko
outfit.
dialogues.text:
They were inspired by Tamaki's exploits while in her Miko
outfit.

dialogues.jp:
それを聞いて、嬉しそうな環をみて、俺も嬉し
くなってしまった。
dialogues.en:
Tamaki was overjoyed upon hearing the good news, making me
happy as well.
dialogues.text:
Tamaki was overjoyed upon hearing the good news, making me
happy as well.
